name: Alija del Infantado (Spain)
description: Divided diagonally from the lower hoist to the upper fly, white above and red below, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Alija del Infantado (a castle on red and a tree above waves).
history: Municipal flag of Alija del Infantado; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.
